open_leads.title: F6 press release on Cisco Expressway CVE-2026-76466 exploitation (indicators, Erlang log entry, port advice)
open_leads.note: Primary researcher report; answered 403 to automated reading, so details came via SecurityWeek and Security Affairs. Recheck if Cisco revises its advisory to confirm exploitation or gives indicators.

notes: Analysis written with confidence medium: Cisco advisory read in full but not revised since 21 Oct 2026 and silent on exploitation; attack details only secondhand from F6 via two news sites. Cisco's title says remote code execution and its cause is persistent cookies plus weak client certificate validation; CISA names it hard-coded credentials (CWE-798). PoC repository linked by news sites was not opened. analyst.mjs check: valid.
